name: four_bit
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
XDUT (rst sample sar residue integrate clk_sar zoom clk_zoom rst_zoom) zoom_timing nbits=4 step=8e-10 frame=1.8e-08
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-9
tran tran stop=4.5e-08 maxstep=2e-11
save rst sample sar residue integrate clk_sar zoom clk_zoom rst_zoom
